title: Gravity
description: Whenever you play a card this turn, deal [blue]2[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: Whenever you play a card this turn, deal [blue]2[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Triggers once per card played. The power tracks individual cards to prevent multiple triggers on replayed cards (e.g., Gravity Well). Removed at the end of the player's turn.
